The petitioners assert to be the owners in possession of the land bearing Sy.Nos.82/1, 83/1, 83/2 all situated at Hebbal Village, Mudhol Taluk.

The subject lands are proposed to be acquired for the purpose of Railway Line from Bagalkot to Kudachi by issuing a notification dated 15.07.2023 under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, 'the Act, 2013').

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The petitioners filed objections to the proposal to acquire the subject land as contemplated under Section 15 of the Act,
2013.

The petitioners' apprehension is that the respondents without adhering to the provisions contained in Section 15 of the Act, 2013 are likely to acquire to the subject lands by issuing final notification under Section 19 of the Act, 2013.

The petitioners' apprehension is unfounded since no material is placed to substantiate that the respondents without following the procedure prescribed under Section 15 of the Act, 2013 are likely to issue final notification.

2. Therefore, the petition stands disposed of directing respondent No.2 to consider the objections filed by the petitioners and pass appropriate orders after providing an opportunity of hearing the petitioners as contemplated under Section 15 of the Act, 2013.

Sd/-
